buyers: two or three sentences: which companies buy it and why
buyer_roles: job titles of the people who buy or use it
buyer_industries: short lowercase phrases for the kinds of companies that buy it, e.g. mortgage lending
news_queries: short phrases describing the buyers' businesses, for the funding news search, e.g. mortgage lender raises
hire_keywords: job-title phrases that mean a company is building the team that buys this
ops_pain_keywords: job-title phrases for people hired to do by hand what this product automates, e.g. loan processor
ops_pain_reason: They're hiring people to do by hand what ... automates.
funding_reason: why a fresh raise makes a company a good lead for them
